rooms.label: Living room
rooms.note: 20 to 22 C is the range Berlin tenant advice treats as sufficient when the contract says nothing.

rooms.label: Kitchen
rooms.note: Kitchens are held to the same range as living rooms.

rooms.label: Bathroom
rooms.note: The bathroom carries the highest figure, 23 C, because you are wet and standing still in it.

rooms.label: Bedroom
rooms.note: A bedroom is a living room during the day. Only the night window is different.
